items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Howard tried to give it and everything, and people would never give it to nobody.

ctx.x: He talked about these four numbers. He had the Celestine's band to try to play it when they worked at the paddock. He said they couldn't play it at all.

That might be the number I'm talking about. Could be some of the same ones. Yeah, same number I'm talking about. I'm afraid they're lost. We stood on that number, I mean, very near a week. Because I had a certain beat I had to make, I mean, and the trambone player, the trambone player was the one he had the last part, you know what I mean? There's a little ending on it, like a coda or something on the other. Yeah. Yeah. And all that part, he had to make, that was something. I had to come in right with, I mean, I…
